#### Read in the data
```{r reading the data}

# Load the mRNA count matrices
mg1.hashtag <- readRDS("Objects/Protocol_optimization/seurat.mg1.hashtag_singlets.rds")
mg2.hashtag <- readRDS("Objects/Protocol_optimization/seurat.mg2.hashtag_singlets.rds")

# Set the identities to the HTO ones
Idents(mg1.hashtag) <- "hash.ID"
Idents(mg2.hashtag) <- "hash.ID"

DefaultAssay(mg1.hashtag) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(mg2.hashtag) <- "RNA"

```

#### Add metadata for each sample where HTO[...] is substituted with a letter
```{r substitute HTO with letter}

library(stringi)

condition1 <- mg1.hashtag@meta.data$HTO_maxID
# We will perform regex in two steps because if we add "HTO1" to be replaced in the first step, it will replace with "A" also "HTO1_0" and "HTO1_3"
condition1 <- stri_replace_all_regex(condition1,
                                  pattern=c("HTO3", "HTO4", "HTO5", "HTO6", "HTO7", "HTO8", "HTO9", "HTO10", "HTO13"),
                                  replacement=c("B", "C", "D","E", "F", "G","H", "I", "J"),
                                  vectorize=FALSE)
condition1 <- stri_replace_all_regex(condition1,
                                  pattern=c("HTO1"),
                                  replacement=c("A"),
                                  vectorize=FALSE)
mg1.hashtag[["condition"]] <- condition1
#mg1.hashtag[["replicate"]] <- "replicate1"


condition2 <- mg2.hashtag@meta.data$HTO_maxID
condition2 <- stri_replace_all_regex(condition2,
                                  pattern=c("HTO3", "HTO4", "HTO5", "HTO6", "HTO7", "HTO8", "HTO9", "HTO10", "HTO13"),
                                  replacement=c("B", "C", "D","E", "F", "G","H", "I", "J"),
                                  vectorize=FALSE)
condition2 <- stri_replace_all_regex(condition2,
                                  pattern=c("HTO1"),
                                  replacement=c("A"),
                                  vectorize=FALSE)
mg2.hashtag[["condition"]] <- condition2
#mg2.hashtag[["replicate"]] <- "replicate2"

```

# Quality control
#### Merge data
```{r merge all data}

merged <- merge(mg1.hashtag, mg2.hashtag)
merged <- NormalizeData(merged) %>%
  PercentageFeatureSet("^MT-", col.name = "percent.mt")

```


#### QC and integration
```{r check QC pre-filtering}

# reorder the samples in the metadata to appear in the order desired by us
cond_levels <- factor(c("A", "B", "C", "D","E", "F", "G","H", "I", "J"))
merged$condition <- factor(merged$condition, levels = cond_levels)
Idents(merged) <- "condition"
# generate color palette based on vintage_cols palette
col_sample <-setNames(c(c("#002C3D", "#03707E", "#66BCB0", "#5F6C25", "#BBA834", "#E7A624", "#CA6702", "#C33708", "#971E1C", "#A74E8D")), cond_levels)

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/nFeature_pre-QC.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/nCount_pre-QC.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/percent.mt_pre-QC.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

```

#### Set thresholds to filter out low quality cells or droplets
```{r set thresholds for QC}

# Number of cells before filtering
table(merged$orig.ident)  
# replicate1 7870
# replicate1 7586

# Filter out cells
merged <- subset(merged, subset = nFeature_RNA > 600 & nCount_RNA > 1000 & percent.mt < 20)

# Number of cells after filtering
table(merged$orig.ident)  
# replicate1 7750
# replicate1 7445

```

#### Check QC post-filtering
```{r check QC post-filtering}

# plot
pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/nFeature_post-QC.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nFeature_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/nCount_post-QC.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("nCount_RNA"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/percent.mt_post-QC.pdf", width = 7, height = 5)
VlnPlot(merged, features = c("percent.mt"), cols = col_sample)
dev.off()

```

#### Cell cycle in each sample
```{r check cell cycle phases in each sample}

seurat <- NormalizeData(merged) %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000) %>%
  CellCycleScoring(g2m.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$g2m.genes, s.features = cc.genes.updated.2019$s.genes)

phases <- as.data.frame(table(seurat$condition, seurat$Phase))
phases$Var1 <- factor(x = phases$Var1)
phases$Var2 <- factor(x = phases$Var2, levels = c( "G1", "S", "G2M"))

colnames(phases)[which(names(phases) == "Var1")] <- "Condition"
colnames(phases)[which(names(phases) == "Var2")] <- "Phase"

# Stacked
pdf("Plots/Protocol_optimization/prop_cells_in_phase_per_condition.pdf",  width = 10, height = 6)
ggplot(phases, aes(fill=Phase, y=Freq, x=Condition)) + 
      geom_bar(position="fill", stat="identity") + 
    ggplot2::theme_classic() + 
    xlab("Cell type") + 
    ylab("Proporion of cells in cell cycle phases") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c("#bdbdbd", "#737373",  "#252525")) +
   theme(axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13), axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 16)) 
dev.off()

```


```{r integrate}

blacklist <- c(unlist(cc.genes.updated.2019), grep("^MT-", rownames(seurat), value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
VariableFeatures(seurat) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat), blacklist)
seurat <- ScaleData(seurat, vars.to.regress = c("G2M.Score","S.Score", "percent.mt", "nFeature_RNA")) %>%
  RunPCA(npcs = 30, verbose=F) 

library(simspec)
seurat <- cluster_sim_spectrum(seurat, label_tag="orig.ident", cluster_resolution = 1)
seurat <- RunUMAP(seurat, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat,"css")), reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_", seed = 46)

seurat <- FindNeighbors(seurat, reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat,"css"))) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.1) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.2) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.3) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.4) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.5) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.6) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.8) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 10)

```
